claims.statement: The CLI is a Click group configured with a custom _DefaultGroup class and default_command='convert', so invoking the tool with no subcommand runs the extraction pipeline as long as the first argument is not a known subcommand or a help flag.

The CLI ships two installable entry points: knowledge-extractor (mapping to knowledge_extractor.cli:main) and convert (mapping to knowledge_extractor.cli:convert_main), both defined in pyproject.toml.

The convert command accepts --input (required), --output (default ./output), --temp (default ./temp), --model (default openai/gpt-6-luna), --translate-from (unset), --translate-model (default mistralai/mistral-large-2512), and --dry-run (flag).
The --translate-from value is sanitized before use: control characters and newlines cause a click.BadParameter error, preventing prompt injection via the flag value.

The clear command removes the temp directory by default and optionally the output directory with --all; it lists directories to remove, prompts for confirmation (default no), and uses shutil.rmtree with ignore_errors=True.
The lint command re-lints all markdown files in a given directory (required positional argument), using pymarkdownlnt for files at or below 512 KB and a fast regex-based fixer for larger files.

The reindex command rebuilds a single root index.md and manifest.json from Markdown already on disk, with no extraction, AI, or linting; by default it removes verified generated nested artifacts but preserves user-content index.md files and skips hidden directories.

The convert command implements incremental processing: it skips source files whose output Markdown already exists, and when --translate-from is set and files are skipped, a warning is logged that existing outputs are not re-translated.

The --translate-from flag triggers a final translation pass after cleanup and before linting, using --translate-model (falling back to --model), preserving code blocks, LaTeX, tables, URLs, and Mermaid structure, and requiring an API key.
In dry-run mode, the pipeline logs which files would be processed and which would be skipped, then exits without processing.

Each pending file goes through a staged pipeline: extract, formulas (LaTeX conversion), OCR (for scanned PDFs), heuristic filter, AI image analysis, AI cleanup (skipped for scanned PDFs), optional AI translation, write final output, and markdown lint.

If an AIProviderError is raised during processing, the pipeline logs the error and aborts; other exceptions are caught per-file and logged, with the failed count included in the final summary and a non-zero exit code if any failures occurred.
File discovery walks the input tree with rglob, skips .git directories, and only yields files whose lowercased suffix is in the SUPPORTED set: .docx, .pptx, .xlsx, .pdf, .jpg, .jpeg, .png.

After processing all files, generate_index rebuilds the root index.md (grouped by original folder structure) and manifest.json (JSON array with path, title, group, headings, and word_count), and logs AI usage summary per distinct model and a lint summary.
